claims.statement: A Ukrainian applicant may create a Cuenta UChile with a valid passport rather than a Chilean identity card, so ClaveÚnica is not listed as a requirement to access the electronic application.

claims.condition: She uses her valid Ukrainian passport and email.

claims.statement: The exact online route is Cuenta UChile at https://cuenta.uchile.cl/ followed by the revalidation module https://ucampus.uchile.cl/m/prorrectoria_revalidacion_postulacion/; the applicant completes the form and uploads PDFs there.

claims.statement: For the original-document appointment, Universidad de Chile says an applicant who cannot attend personally may send a third party holding a notarised power of attorney; post-change national rules also require an apostilled/legalised foreign power when a third party files the request.

claims.statement: The present UChile payment instructions make a fully completed filing from Ukraine operationally uncertain: the 2-UTM entry fee must be paid in Chilean pesos from a Chilean account or by Santander deposit, and the third-party-transfer instruction asks for the applicant's RUT although she has none.

claims.condition: The Oficina must confirm an acceptable payment/reference method for a passport-holder without RUT; her son may potentially pay only if they confirm it.

claims.statement: For a foreign medical degree, the required evidence includes apostilled/legalised original diploma, grades, curriculum and professional-authorisation documents, plus the complete course programmes, passport, and Spanish translations; Russian/Ukrainian documents therefore need translation before filing.

sources.title: Revalidación y Reconocimiento
sources.quote_original: Diploma de título o grado original, legalizado vía consular o apostillado (no se aceptan copias ni fondos negros)

sources.title: Revalidación y Reconocimiento

claims.statement: After UChile accepts the digital record, its stated operational sequence is: official registration (about 20 working days), referral to the Faculty of Medicine's academic unit, a 3-UTM curricular study, then a result of approval, denial, or academic requirements.

claims.condition: Her application passes admissibility and is registered.

claims.statement: Under the post-17-August-2026 regulation, partial equivalence of at least 70% may lead to general or subject-specific examinations, final graduation activities, and/or additional curricular activities; every exam may be attempted up to three times and is only pass/fail.

claims.statement: Universidad de Chile's Medicine page currently lists a combined 'Examen Teórico y Examen Práctico' fee, but no current official Medicine source found specifies the number of papers/stations, written versus oral format, subjects, language, pass mark, or a 2026 examination calendar; those details must not be assumed from older material.

claims.statement: For applications submitted from 17 August 2026, the official national maximum fees are up to 2 UTM for filing/admissibility, 3 UTM for academic analysis, 15 UTM for all assigned examinations/final activities as a set, and 20 UTM for all additional curricular activities as a set; payments use the UTM of the payment month.

claims.statement: There is no statutory end-to-end maximum: the current regulation gives 30 working days to request the academic report, 45 for the curricular study, and allows up to two years for assigned requirements; UChile separately states a minimum duration of six months, which is an institutional operational statement rather than observed case-duration evidence.

process_steps.name: Prepare admissibility documents: apostilled degree, grades, plan, professional authorisation, full programmes, passport, translations, and signed declaration.
process_steps.actor: Applicant in Ukraine; Ukrainian university/competent authorities; translator
documents: Apostilled curriculum/plan with hours or credits

process_steps.name: Create Cuenta UChile using passport and enter Ucampus revalidation module; complete the form and upload PDFs.
Pay filing/admissibility fee and submit. Payment must be in CLP from a Chilean account or Santander deposit; her no-RUT payment reference must be confirmed first.
After admissibility approval, book the original-document verification appointment; attend herself or send an authorised representative with power and the original apostilled documents.
process_steps.actor: Applicant or mandatario/apoderado; Oficina de Revalidación
documents: Notarial power; apostilled/legalised if granted abroad

process_steps.name: UChile registers and routes the file; the Faculty of Medicine/Unidad de Coordinación Revalidación performs curriculum review and notifies the result.
process_steps.actor: Oficina de Revalidación; Faculty of Medicine academic unit

process_steps.name: If partial equivalence is found, fulfil assigned examinations, final activities, and/or extra curriculum. Examination specifications and 2026 schedule are not publicly verified.
process_steps.cost_as_of: 2026-09-03 statutory maximum for the set of exams/final activities; additional curriculum can be up to 20 UTM

process_steps.name: Receive revalidation decision and request the diploma/certificate under UChile's document-issuance procedure.
process_steps.cost_as_of: 2026-09-03; UChile’s current post-change issuance amount not publicly verified

open_questions.question: Will the Oficina accept her third-party payment and identify the applicant by passport number rather than RUT, so that a no-RUT applicant can submit a complete Ucampus file from Ukraine?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The official payment instructions require a Chilean payment channel and tell third-party payers to include a RUT that she does not possess.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Email contactorevalidacion@uchile.cl and boletasrevalida@u.uchile.cl with her passport-only status; obtain a written answer before paying.

open_questions.question: May her son or another Chile-based mandatario present the physical apostilled originals at the cotejo, and what exact wording/power and identity documents will the Office accept?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This determines whether she must travel to Santiago before the academic review.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request written confirmation from the Oficina and have the proposed power reviewed for Chilean apostille/legalisation requirements.

open_questions.question: What is the 2026 Medicine-specific examination protocol: components, subjects, language, pass standard, dates, physical location, and any capacity limits?
open_questions.why_it_matters: She has no Spanish and cannot plan travel, study or elapsed time without this information.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask serevalida.med@uchile.cl for the current ERM/revalidation protocol and the next available examination dates.

open_questions.question: Has Universidad de Chile published its exact post-17-August-2026 institutional charge schedule, including diploma/certificate issuance fees, rather than only the statutory caps?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The undated Faculty page has CLP issuance figures that cannot safely be treated as 2026 fees.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request the current written fee schedule and payment instructions before filing.

open_questions.question: Does the Faculty accept the Ukrainian 'кандидат медичних наук' as a separate doctorate-recognition application, and what evidence of equivalence is needed?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is potentially relevant to academic employment but is distinct from Médico Cirujano revalidation.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Oficina whether to file a separate recognition request and provide the degree record, thesis and curriculum.

unknowns_declared: No post-17-August-2026 UChile Medicine source was found that publishes the current examination structure, formats, subjects, Spanish-language rule, pass mark, dates, or observed completion times.

No official source found proves that the applicant herself must attend the cotejo; the official UChile search snippet says a person with notarial power may attend, but confirmation that this person may carry her apostilled originals is still required.
No official source found confirms a workable UChile payment path for a passport-holder with no RUT, no Chilean bank account and no residence.
The UChile pages describing the historic exclusive/monopoly regime are undated or pre-change and were not used to assert that exclusivity survives after 2026-08-17.
No 2026 observed real-world median/percentile duration was found; only UChile’s stated minimum of six months and the regulatory milestones are evidenced.
Family reunification through her son could be relevant to immigration later, but it does not appear in the UChile revalidation procedure and has not been assumed here.
